description_full:
Info magang dari PT Innolab Sains Internasional (Kalgen Innolab)

OPEN INTERNSHIP!

PT Innolab Sains Internasional (Kalgen Innolab) is looking for a Digital Marketing Intern to join our team 📢

Responsibilities:
- Assist in the production and management of social media content
- Ensure that content aligns with the company's branding guidelines
- Support design and content requirements for marketing campaigns
- Collaborate with the Digital Marketing team to implement content strategies

Requirements:
-Undergraduate student or fresh graduate Diploma / Bachelor Degree in DKV/Marcomm/Communication Science
-Understanding of graphic design and branding principles
-Familiarity with digital content trends and video editing
-Ability to create creative and engaging content
-Proficiency in using Canva, CapCut, or Adobe software
-Ability to work collaboratively in a team and meet deadlines
-Work from Office
-Willing to work for minimum 6 months period of internship

Placement: East Jakarta, Pulomas

Apply here: bit.ly/LamaranInnolab

⚠️ Please note!
PT Innolab Sains Internasional (Kalgen Innolab) does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
